profile.headline: Driving the future at Ford EV
profile.summary:
Pioneering, goal-oriented computer engineer with a strong history of coordinating full life cycle design and development of leading-edge integrated hardware and embedded software systems. Well-versed in fundamental aspects of computer architecture, with practical experience in firmware and driver development and implementation. Poised and knowledgeable in conveying highly technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Skilled coach and mentor of top-notch technical teams.

Specialties: Speech Recognition, MPEG4/H.264 Codec, Multimedia Signal Processing, VHDL/Verilog, FPGA System on Chip(SOC), Xilinx ISE/EDK, Microblaze BSB design.

positions.title: Sr. SoC SW Engineer - CCG / Chrome Linux System Software
positions.description:
Contributed to Intel Core Silicon Power-On and Reference Platform (RVP/CEP) bring-up for Chromebook and Chromebox releases, ensuring timely execution of Functional Requirements (FRs) across multiple domains including:
- CNVi (Integrated Connectivity module Wi-Fi and Bluetooth): 
* Enabled integrated Wi-Fi and Bluetooth IPs in the SoC with RF cards that support Wi-Fi 7 and BLE. Verified ACPI power domain for RF and AP modules.
* Debugged Wi-Fi and Bluetooth firmware integration with drivers to ensure compliance with Intel vPro certification requirements.
- TCSS (Type-C Subsystem): 
* Enabled and validated USB 3/4, Type-C, and Thunderbolt features on Intel Core platforms.
* Collaborated on and debugged issues in EC firmware and Coreboot to meet timing and power requirements (RTD3) according to specifications.
* Reviewed and validated Coreboot GPIO and ACPI configurations and mappings against the datasheet and schematic.
* Automated Type-C testing procedures with multiple docks and peripherals using Bash, TAST scripts, and Go language to reduce testing time and minimize human errors during DPMO/DPMT (defects per million opportunities/time units).
- 5G/WWAN (Wireless WAN): 
* Optimized and refactored code to upstream the first 5G WWAN Linux driver based on Fibocom and MediaTek modem. Also enabled coredump API features that support the essential debug feature for modem firmware.
* net: wwan: t7xx: PCIe driver for MediaTek M.2 modem: https://lwn.net/Articles/874559/

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Imaging Camera Group
positions.locationName: Santa Clara County, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Main focus on next generation Camera Imaging solutions, driver and firmware design, implementation and deployment on Intel based SoC platforms. Selected projects include…
- Developed camera drivers for Linux running on several generations of Intel IPUs (TGL, JSL).
- Design, development and debug of Intel Camera Video and Capture pipeline firmware IP across all platforms, operating systems and form-factors. Implementation of imaging algorithms for multi-core VLIW (Local tone mapping, Temporal Noise Reduction, Stitching)
- Imaging solutions for laptops, smart phones, Surveillance and ADAS with various IoT vendors.
- Algorithms cover HDR, Low light imaging, 3A (AE, AWB, AF) controls on Android and Linux Camera HAL and Linux kernels and sensor drivers.
- Automated camera testing frameworks and analyzed imaging quality with Imatest tools.
- Developed and released Imaging Firmware Development Kit (FDK) which enables users to develop imaging kernels and test in a standalone environment using APIs. Performance compared with OpenCL.
- Optimized imaging pipelines on intel’s first Android phones and tablets (Baytrail, Cherrytrail+)
- Enabled and brought up various camera sensor modules (HDR, automotive, anti flicker).
- Security sequence enablement in IPU system boot / loading process.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Mobile Computing Group
positions.locationName: Santa Clara County, California, United States
positions.description:
Main focus on next generation Audio solutions and low power audio driver and firmware design, implementation and deployment on Intel based SoC platforms. Selected projects include…
- Low-power Audio Firmware Development: Tested and validated audio firmware architecture based on a low-power SoC; End-to-end design and development of offload based new audio firmware architecture for low power tablet.
- Driver Development for Windows 8: Worked on WDM based WaveRT Audio Driver on Windows 8; Also worked on audio drivers for HDMI and Bluetooth (Hands Free Profile)
- Pre-System Validation: Tested and validated drivers and system setups on FPGA based CR4 system; Effectively achieved validation and modifications of the audio system on Windows8 and Android platform emulators.
- Power On Develop: Participated in a system bring up conference for a next generation platform; Successfully finished the early stage system enabling process. Fully understood the condition of early stage system and communicated with various team members to get the project done on time.

positions.title: Sr. Hardware / Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Multi-channel Data Acquisition System Design (RFID), Interface Boards Design using ARM, MSP430 processors, Simulator / Emulator / Analyzer Programming with MFC, Visual C++, JAVA.
